commentary: A sharp 350-point Nifty relief rally led by IT heavyweights masks underlying market fragility. With market breadth scores at an anemic 37 and our deterministic gate flagged WEAK, Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil market-direction discipline mandates defensive posture. Relief rallies driven by narrow mega-cap short covering frequently lure capital into distribution traps while secondary breadth remains subdued. Without confirmed follow-through across leading industry groups, progressive exposure must remain strictly restrained. Capital must be preserved by engaging only pristine Stage 2 setups with confirmed earnings acceleration, tight bases, and institutional sponsorship, while strictly enforcing Minervini stop discipline across all swing positions.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

21STCENMGM.technical: Price cleared its 20-day high at 46.54 on 3.89x volume above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. However, the move lacks a structured multi-week Stage 2 base, displaying erratic historical swings and heavy overhead supply that undermine durable relative-strength leadership.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Capital market trading firm with highly volatile quarterly results. While Q1 FY27 posted a ₹9 Cr profit, the preceding three quarters suffered net losses. Inconsistent operating margins, lack of institutional sponsorship, and erratic ROCE disqualify it under strict CANSLIM standards.
21STCENMGM.risk: Break below 43.53 invalidates the breakout; Minervini discipline mandates an immediate exit without tolerating micro-cap trading volatility.

ADVANCE.technical: Clearing 20-session high at 141.64 with powerful 11.4x volume expansion, confirming heavy institutional demand. Decisively positioned above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 70 reflecting robust Stage 2 momentum without excessive extension.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Agrochemical manufacturer demonstrating explosive CANSLIM metrics. Q1 FY27 net profit rose 152% on 96% sales growth, supported by 421% PAT growth in Q4 FY26. Solid ROCE (19.6%), low D/E (0.32), and strong Kharif demand provide strong tailwinds.
ADVANCE.risk: A close below 128.51 stop violates breakout support, signaling failed follow-through and demanding strict loss containment.

AEGISLOG.technical: Textbook double-bottom pattern forming a constructive right side and testing 1530.23 neckline pivot. Successfully defended rising 21-EMA with positive MACD above zero. Stage 2 structure remains pristine above rising 50 and 200 SMAs with dry volume on pullbacks.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Dominant liquid and LPG logistics operator delivering 212% YoY PAT growth and 37% revenue expansion in Q1 FY27. High EBITDA margins, port capacity expansions (Kandla, JNPT), and premier institutional sponsorship (GIC, Vanguard) satisfy core CANSLIM criteria.
AEGISLOG.risk: Violation of 1383.96 swing low breaks base symmetry; Minervini rules require immediate capital preservation.

AEROENTER.technical: Double-bottom breakout clearing 159.76 on 5.55x volume, holding firmly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 65. Setup shows solid technical accumulation, though overall consolidation remains relatively young within its broader Stage 2 cycle.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Headline Q1 FY27 PAT surged 617% on 135% sales growth, but results were heavily boosted by ₹144 Cr one-off MRO divestment proceeds. Core operating margins contracted to 9%, warranting CANSLIM earnings-quality caution despite nearly debt-free balance sheet.
AEROENTER.risk: Drop below 146.68 support invalidates base neckline; enforce prompt stop discipline to prevent capital erosion.

AEROFLEX.technical: Tight SEPA volatility contraction within 1.5% of 584.73 pivot. Surging 9.3x volume confirms institutional accumulation above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 63 reflects strong, unextended accumulation ready for Stage 2 continuation.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Flexible hose specialist benefiting from CANSLIM 'N' catalyst via data center liquid cooling orders. Q1 FY27 revenue jumped 72% YoY with PAT up 58% and 23% EBITDA margin. Strong ROCE (>20%) and zero leverage validate leadership quality.
AEROFLEX.risk: Failure below 522.61 violates consolidation base support; exit unconditionally per Minervini risk parameters.

AETHER.technical: Reclaiming intermediate moving averages with double-bottom neckline pressure at 1815.91. MACD above signal line and RSI at 64 confirm constructive upside momentum above rising 50 and 200 SMAs, though breakout volume requires further confirmation.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemicals leader pivoting toward high-margin CRAMS and CEM models. Q1 FY27 PAT jumped 33% on 29% sales growth, though Q4 FY26 was subdued (+7%). Capacity expansion at Site 5 and negligible debt support constructive outlook.
AETHER.risk: Close below 1676.19 breaks the double-bottom pivot floor; cut immediately to protect trading capital.
